name: Rociana del Condado (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue with a broad white stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Rociana del Condado (a palm tree on blue).
history: The arms and flag of Rociana del Condado were approved by the municipal council on 28 March 1996 under decree 263/1996 of the regional government, published in the BOJA on 27 July 1996; the flag is rectangular in the proportion 11:18, composed of three stripes parallel to each other and perpendicular to the hoist, blue, white and blue.

features.role: Rociana del Condado arms — palm tree on blue
